LanguageData.DMS_Drone_VerlingBrid.label: Verling bird
LanguageData.DMS_Drone_VerlingBrid.description: A quadcopter drone built for reconnaissance. It is weak in combat but moves extremely fast. It can be fitted with a small-caliber machine gun or grenades to give it combat capability, and on the rim it is often loaded with explosives and used as a suicide drone.
